summary.zh: 补齐目标客户、定位与品牌语气，形成共享背景
summary.en: Write the shared ICP, positioning and brand voice brief

description.zh: 在营销项目开始时，把目标客户、产品定位和品牌语气整理成一份共享的背景文件，后续的营销工作都以它为输入。适合刚接手项目、或团队对这些基础信息说法不一致时使用。
description.en: Turns ICP, positioning and brand voice into one shared brief that later marketing work reads from. Use it at the start of a project, or when the team describes these basics differently.
